ValidationRule.description: If a sales rep requests a promo on an account, fill in that promo code.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Request_from_Sales_Team__c , "Promo Request"), ISBLANK( Promo_Code__c ) ) && Datevalue(CreatedDate) > DATE(2017,04,01)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in the promo code requested from sales.
